sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Screwjab Dagger T3, Petrifying Bola unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Burst Fire. Ultimate (Petrifying Bola) is available from Burst Fire.

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Burst Fire completes 4,800 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Burst Fire completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 9600 souls (~9.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Intensifying Magazine
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Burst Fire completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Burst Fire completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Burst Fire
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Stamina Mastery completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Stamina Mastery completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-24,000 (levels 15-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Slither T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Lethal Venom, venom max damage) grows from 183 to 282. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 20 to 42 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Split Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Pop it on waves and camps to farm faster.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.caption: Builds toward the 8k weapon tier, which Point Blank completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Point Blank completes 8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 7,200 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Screwjab Dagger: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 62 to 86% weapon damage.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-52,800 (levels 27-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Lethal Venom T3, Petrifying Bola T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Lethal Venom, venom max damage) grows from 282 to 424. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Mercurial Magnum.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (1,600 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 11 to 45 spirit power. Imbued on Screwjab Dagger: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 11,200 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 16,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 22,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Slither (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown. Takes vitality from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: It can't be used while stunned, so pop it before you slide in.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Spirit Shielding.
sections.desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Spirit Shielding.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes stop you sliding in.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry wins the close-range fight.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Veil Walker
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting caught when your slide isn't enough to get away.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 17,600 to 22,400 invested: bonus 54 to 60 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
